nodeURL.description: Ergo node with the extra indexer enabled; used for every read and submit

addressPrefix.description: Network prefix of addresses on this network (0 Ergo mainnet, 16 Ergo testnet). Never read from the node.

minerFee.description: Miner fee per transaction in the smallest native unit

maxMinerFee.description: Highest miner fee a transaction may pay, in the smallest native unit; at least minerFee. Defaults to 10 x minerFee

minerFeeErgoTree.description: ErgoTree (hex) of the miner fee output

tokenListSource.description: Token list file, relative to conf/ and inside conf/tokens/

pendingTxTimeoutBlocks.description: Blocks after which a pending transaction is checked against the node; it is forgotten only on evidence, never for its age while its inputs are unspent

pendingStateFile.description: File that keeps this network's pending transactions across restarts (signed transactions and box ids, never a key), relative to the Gateway folder. Unset: kept in memory only

transactionsExpire.description: Whether a signed transaction can expire before it confirms. False on Ergo: a transaction stays valid until one of its inputs is spent, so a transaction the node does not know may still confirm. A statement for clients; Gateway does not read it

failedAfterConfirmations.description: Confirmations the transaction that spent one of a pending transaction's inputs needs before the pending one is reported failed. Unset: the value of confirmations

submitMode.description: send: signed transactions are submitted to the node, which relays them. check: they are only checked by the node's /transactions/check endpoint and never sent; a swap or transfer then answers an error that names the transaction id and says nothing was sent. Unset: send

swapProvider.description: Default swap provider for the unified trading routes (format: connector/type), e.g. ergodex/amm
